briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China frontier model race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race to deploy next-gen models as regulatory pressure mounts globally. Compute constraints and talent wars define the competitive landscape through mid-2026.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 2T parameters while Anthropic and Google DeepMind counter with Claude 4 and Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4.5 and xAI ships Grok-3. DeepSeek-V3 closes capability gap from China.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. NIST issues new guidelines while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell clusters. Microsoft and Google announce $40B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
